chunks: 5725 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abu Walad al-Hannat, who said: I heard Abu Abdullah عليه السلام say:
"A Muslim inherits from his dhimmi wife, while she does not inherit from him."

key_terms.الْمُسْلِمُ: the Muslim; here, the Muslim husband as the inheriting party
key_terms.امْرَأَتَهُ الذِّمِّيَّةَ: his dhimmi wife, meaning a non-Muslim wife living under Islamic protection
key_terms.يَرِثُ: inherits; receives a share of an estate by legal right

ai.seo_question: Does a Muslim husband inherit from his non-Muslim dhimmi wife in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on inheritance between spouses of different religions. It states that a Muslim husband inherits from his dhimmi wife, but she does not inherit from him.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.5725 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abu Walad Al-Hannat who said:
I heard Abu Abdullah (as) say: "
A Muslim man inherits from his dhimmi (non-Muslim under Islamic protection) wife, but she does not inherit from him."
